problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Solve 0 ∈ F(x) + G(x), where F is L-Lipschitz, G is monotone, and F+G is globally ρ-cohypomonotone: ⟨u−v,x−y⟩ ≥ −ρ‖u−v‖² for u∈(F+G)(x), v∈(F+G)(y). Require L>0, ρ≥0, and 2ρL<1. A solution x★ satisfies ‖x0−x★‖≤R. No objective or saddle-point representation is required.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Exact resolvent access Jγ(z) for every γ>0, satisfying (z−Jγ(z))/γ ∈ G(Jγ(z)). Each stochastic operator evaluation and each resolvent evaluation counts as one oracle call. The extracted budget bounds a fixed total number of calls.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Stochastic operator evaluations g(x,ω), with E[g(x,ω)]=F(x) and E‖g(x,ω)−F(x)‖²≤σ². Each call receives a fresh IID seed; same-seed evaluations at multiple points are not provided. F, G, g, and the sampling law are hidden; Params, including L, ρ, R, σ, ε, and x0, are public.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform second-moment noise bound σ²≥0, unbiasedness, joint measurability, and integrability. No light-tail or samplewise smoothness condition is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension-dependent bound is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Global cohypomonotonicity applies to the entire sum F+G, including all graph elements of G, with margin 1−2ρL>0. Oracle seeds are independent and identically distributed. R bounds distance to an existing solution rather than the diameter of a bounded domain.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned certificate must satisfy a∈G(x) for every outcome, rather than only in expectation or almost surely.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E‖F(x)+a‖≤ε under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return a measurable pair (x,a) with integrable first-power inclusion residual ‖F(x)+a‖. The target is ε>0; no squared-residual, objective-gap, or last-iterate condition is specified.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: A structured inclusion formulation combining global cohypomonotonicity of the sum, IID stochastic operator access, exact resolvents, and an explicitly feasible residual certificate. No repository implementations or proofs were inspected; the absence of a qualifying verified citation is not a novelty claim.

descriptionHtml:
Stochastic Cohypomonotone Inclusions

We consider solving 0∈F(x)+A(x) in a finite-dimensional real inner product space E, where F:E→E is L-Lipschitz and A:E⇉E is monotone. The sum F+A is ρ-cohypomonotone, with L>0, ρ≥0, and 2ρL<1. A given point x0∈E lies within distance R≥0 of a solution. The oracle returns unbiased estimates of F with independent sampling and variance at most σ2, where σ≥0, or exact resolvent evaluations of A. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable pair (x¯,a¯) with a¯∈A(x¯) for every realization and E∥F(x¯)+a¯∥≤ε, averaging over sampling and algorithm randomness.

The inclusion problem is to find x∈E such that 0∈F(x)+A(x). Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. The algorithm receives E, the measurable sample space Ω, L, ρ, R, σ, ε, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Lipschitz continuity and cohypomonotonicity). For every x,y∈E, ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥. For every a∈A(x) and b∈A(y), monotonicity of A and cohypomonotonicity of F+A mean ⟨a−b,x−y⟩≥0,⟨F(x)+a−F(y)−b,x−y⟩≥−ρ∥F(x)+a−F(y)−b∥2.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E satisfying −F(x⋆)∈A(x⋆),∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic operator access). There is a probability measure ν on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For each x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)−F(x)∥2 is integrable under ν, with Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=F(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−F(x)∥2]≤σ2. The samples (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law ν. They are independent of the algorithm’s randomness. A stochastic query at x∈E on call k returns g(x,ξk).

Assumption 4 (Exact resolvent access). There is a map J:R×E→E such that, for every γ>0 and z∈E, z−J(γ,z)γ∈A(J(γ,z)). A resolvent query (γ,z)∈R×E returns J(γ,z) exactly. The stated resolvent condition applies to positive γ.

Each call chooses either a stochastic query or a resolvent query; both count toward the same total oracle-call budget. The index k counts calls of either kind.

The output (x¯,a¯)∈E×E must be measurable and satisfy a¯∈A(x¯) for every realization. Its residual norm must be integrable and obey EP[∥F(x¯)+a¯∥]≤ε, where P is the joint law of the oracle samples and the independent algorithm randomness.

comparisonHtml:
In a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, F is L-Lipschitz and G is monotone with an everywhere-defined exact resolvent JγG for every γ>0. For v∈(F+G)(x) and w∈(F+G)(y), ⟨v−w,x−y⟩≥−ρ∥v−w∥2, with L>0 and 0≤2ρL<1. A zero x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. The jointly measurable oracle g has integrable samples and squared errors, ∫g(x,ω)dp=F(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)−F(x)∥2dp≤σ2; samples are IID with law p under P. Target: a measurable pair (x¯,u) with u∈G(x¯) on every path and ∫∥F(x¯)+u∥dP≤ε. Parameters L,ρ,R,σ,ε are supplied; R,σ≥0, ε>0. Costs count every F sample and every resolvent evaluation.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMonotone

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.StochasticCohypomonotoneInclusion

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE Params.measurableE Params.borelE
  Params.measurableΩ

def reply {E Ω : Type} (g : E → Ω → E) (J : ℝ → E → E) (q : E ⊕ (ℝ × E)) (ω : Ω) : E :=
  Sum.elim (fun x => g x ω) (fun γz => J γz.1 γz.2) q

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := (p.E → p.E) × (p.E → Set p.E)
  Query p := p.E ⊕ (ℝ × p.E)
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E × p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.ρ ∧ 2 * q.ρ * q.L < 1 ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q I O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (J : ℝ → q.E → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ q => reply g J q.2 } ∧
      (∀ γ z, 0 < γ → γ⁻¹ • (z - J γ z) ∈ I.2 (J γ z)) ∧
      (∀ x y, ∀ a ∈ I.2 x, ∀ b ∈ I.2 y, 0 ≤ ⟪a - b, x - y⟫) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖I.1 x - I.1 y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ∀ a ∈ I.2 x, ∀ b ∈ I.2 y,
        -q.ρ * ‖(I.1 x + a) - (I.1 y + b)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪(I.1 x + a) - (I.1 y + b), x - y⟫) ∧
      (∃ xstar, -I.1 xstar ∈ I.2 xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.IsStochasticOperator (p : Measure _) I.1 g q.σ
  successful q I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ (∀ ω, (output ω).2 ∈ I.2 (output ω).1) ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => ‖I.1 (output ω).1 + (output ω).2‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      ∫ ω, ‖I.1 (output ω).1 + (output ω).2‖ ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.StochasticCohypomonotoneInclusion
